title: lovely roasted australian beef roast
description: A delicious, easy-to-make roasted beef roast dish featuring a rich beurre-noisette and marinated Australian beef.
instructions: Season the Australian beef roast with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Sear the beef roast on all sides until browned, about 2 minutes per side.
Transfer the beef roast to a large baking dish.
Add the sliced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the red wine and lemon juice, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet.
Bring the liquid to a simmer and cook until reduced by half, about 5 minutes.
Brush the beurre-noisette over the beef roast and add the sprigs of rosemary and thyme.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes per kilogram, or until the beef reaches your desired level of doneness.
Remove the beef from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
